title: vaximile pipeline parameters
description: Tumor neoantigen discovery using paired tumour-normal bulk DNA and RNA sequencing

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

samplesheet.description: Path to comma-separated file describing the patients, samples and FastQ files.

capture_kits.description: Path to comma-separated file mapping capture kit names to their BED target files.

vep_cache.description: Path to a local Ensembl VEP cache directory matching the chosen reference genome.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome, annotation and transcriptome files.

reference_fa.description: Reference genome FASTA. Gzipped input is decompressed and indexed automatically.

reference_includes_chr_prefix.description: Set to false when the reference contigs are named without a 'chr' prefix.

gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF used for RNA alignment, quantification and fusion calling.

transcriptome_reference.description: Transcriptome FASTA used to build the kallisto and salmon indices.

human_ref_peptides.description: Reference proteome peptide FASTA used by pVACtools for reference proteome similarity.

alignment_index_options.title: Alignment index options
alignment_index_options.description: Prebuilt indices. Any left unset are built from the reference during the run.

bwa_index.description: Directory containing a prebuilt bwa-mem2 index.

star_index.description: Directory containing a prebuilt STAR 2.7.10 index.

salmon_index.description: Directory containing a prebuilt salmon index.

variant_calling_options.title: Variant calling options
variant_calling_options.description: Interval scattering behaviour for the GATK-based callers.

intervals_file.description: Interval list restricting variant calling. Defaults to the GATK hg38 WGS calling regions.

interval_padding.description: Bases of padding added around each calling interval.

scatter_count.description: Number of interval shards to scatter variant calling across.

hla_typing_options.title: HLA typing options
hla_typing_options.description: Reference data for MHC region extraction and HLA allele calling.

hla_fasta_fai.description: Index for the HLA reference FASTA.

hla_kmers.description: Unique HLA k-mer file used by the typing tools.

gatk_resource_options.title: GATK resource bundle options
gatk_resource_options.description: Known-sites VCFs used for BQSR, contamination estimation and somatic filtering. Each must have a matching .tbi.

common_germline.description: Common germline biallelic SNP sites for contamination estimation.

known_sites_dbsnp.description: dbSNP known sites VCF for BQSR.

pon.description: Panel of normals VCF for Mutect2.

hapmap.description: HapMap VCF for germline variant recalibration.

somalier_sites.description: Sites VCF used by somalier for relatedness checks.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
